property_summary: For any caller that deposited >0, calling withdrawAll must always leave the contract's ETH balance reduced exactly by the withdrawn amount (i.e., address(c).balance == priorBalance - withdrawn) — the mutant allowing reentrancy can cause additional reentrant withdrawals so the final contract balance is lower than expected for some attacker and deposit amount.
change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender.call{value: oCredit}("") before zeroing the caller's credit (introduces reentrancy vulnerability changing post-withdrawAll state).
